prompt:

Scene: A large clock shows a softly highlighted band around one hour beside a traveler.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "ungefär ≈ about, not exactly.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Det tar ungefär en timme.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
Reference image is STYLE AND LAYOUT ONLY. Match its cream-and-gold header, blue/cream surroundings, photographic illustration quality, navy rounded type, gold memory caption and blue bottom example strip. Create the new scene, not the cat scene. Keep all teaching text integrated. Output a square individual card. For överge, the word-part bridge is only a memory aid; label it 'Memory trick'.
